manipulated_prompt_obj.content:
You are playing a collaborative word guessing game in which you have to describe a target word for another player to guess.

Rules:
(a) You have to reply in the form: CLUE: <some text>. Guesses from the other player will start with GUESS:.
(b) You cannot use the target word itself, parts or morphological variants of it in your description.
(c) In addition, the same rules apply for related words which are provided below.

End conditions:
(i) If you use the target word or a related word in your description, then you lose.
(ii) If the other player can guess the target word in 3 tries, you both win.

Let us start.

This is the target word that you need to describe and that the other player needs to guess:

webpage

Related words are:

- adblocker
- backlink
- blinkie

Important: You are under time pressure, give short descriptions that are to the point!

message.content: CLUE: A document you view in your browser when visiting a site online
message.reasoning:
I need to describe the word "webpage" without using:
- webpage
- adblocker
- backlink
- blinkie

Let me think of a good clue that describes what a webpage is without using these words.

A webpage is a document that is displayed on the internet/browser. It's what you see when you visit a website. Each site has one or more of these.

I could say something like:
"A document you view in a browser when you visit a site"
"An online document displayed in your internet browser"
"What you're looking at when you visit a website"

Let me be careful not to use "page" since that's part of the target word "webpage". Let me also avoid "web" as it's part of the compound word.

Better options:
- "An online document displayed in your internet browser"
- "A digital document you view when browsing the internet"
- "The content displayed in a browser window when you visit a site"

I think "A document you view in your browser when visiting a site" works well. It's descriptive without using the target word or related words.
